item.title: Gulls Take Third Straight with Win Over Silver Knights
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls extended their win streak to three as they defeated the Henderson Silver Knights tonight at Pechanga Arena San Diego, 7-4. The seven goals scored ties San Diego’s scoring record this season, becoming the second time the team has found the back of the net that many times. item.title: Calle Clang Named To 2026 AHL All-Star Classic Presented By BMO
item.description: The American Hockey League (AHL) announced today that goaltender Calle Clang has been named to the 2026 AHL All-Star Classic presented by BMO, to be held February 10-11 in Rockford, Ill. Clang, 23 (5/20/02), joins forward Tim Washe at the 2026 All-Star Classic, the fourth time in franchise history the Gulls have had two All-Star representatives and the first since 2020 (Chris Wideman and Anthony Stolarz, Ontario). item.title: Breakthrough Between the Pipes: Calle Clang's Road to AHL All-Star
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com Calle Clang is turning more and more heads while protecting the crease for the San Diego Gulls this season. The 23-year-old Sweden native is competing in his third full AHL season and has been finding success beyond what he has seen in previous years. The goaltender has proved himself enough to be named an AHL All-Star. item.title: Gulls Secure Win Over Bakersfield Condors
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls returned from the All-Star break with a victory over the Bakersfield Condors at Dignity Health Arena tonight, 3-1. Goaltender Tomas Suchanek made his sixth appearance of the season tonight, saving 31-of-32 shots. Suchanek did not let up a goal until the final two minutes of the game, securing his second win of the season. item.title: Gulls’ Comeback Falls Short vs. Condors
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls came just short of the Bakersfield Condors tonight at Pechanga Arena San Diego, 5-4. item.title: Anaheim Ducks Reassign Ian Moore To San Diego
item.description: The Anaheim Ducks announced today that the National Hockey League (NHL) club has reassigned defenseman Ian Moore to the San Diego Gulls, Anaheim’s primary development affiliate in the American Hockey League (AHL). In addition, the Gulls have assigned forward Coulson Pitre and defenseman Konnor Smith to Tulsa. item.title: Gulls’ Late Heroics Not Enough in Shootout Loss to Barracuda
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls forced overtime with a late goal over the San Jose Barracuda but were unable to grab the extra point in the shootout tonight at Pechanga Arena San Diego, 4-3. The Gulls proved how hard they play until the very end as late heroics kept the team alive once again when Ryan Carpenter found the game-tying goal with only five seconds remaining in the final frame.
